edits.current:
Indemnity for dismissal without just cause (CST art. 64). Fully taxable and enters the ordinary monthly base; only the statutory-minimum indemnities of ET art. 206 nums. 1-3 are exempt, and then only up to the legal minimum (art. 206 par. 1).

Source: WT 62180 'Severance/Layoff Payment-CLA' and WT 62181 'Severance/Layoff Payment- Non CLA'. Despite the word 'Severance', these are the dismissal indemnity (CST art. 64 / CLA), NOT cesantias (NIE120). Wage types are not mapped to NIE120 or NIE160 by the word 'Severance' alone.
edits.proposed:
Indemnity for dismissal without just cause (CST art. 64), reported at its gross amount. It is NOT merged into the ET art. 383 / art. 388 monthly withholding base: it is withheld separately under ET art. 401-3 at the flat 20% where the employee's monthly income exceeds 204 UVT (COP 10,684,296 in 2026) and is not withheld below that threshold, after the 25% exempt labour income of ET art. 206 num. 10 within its statutory limit; only the statutory-minimum indemnities of ET art. 206 nums. 1-3 are exempt, and then only up to the legal minimum (art. 206 par. 1). The withholding so practised is WT 21129 'Personal Income Tax Withholding-Terminations' and is reported in RetencionFuente (NIE177) together with WT 2552.

Source: WT 62180 'Severance/Layoff Payment-CLA' and WT 62181 'Severance/Layoff Payment- Non CLA'. Despite the word 'Severance', these are the dismissal indemnity (CST art. 64 / CLA), NOT cesantias (NIE120). Wage types are not mapped to NIE120 or NIE160 by the word 'Severance' alone.
edits.reason: The current first paragraph says the indemnity 'enters the ordinary monthly base'. In law the dismissal indemnity is withheld separately under ET art. 401-3 (20% above 204 UVT, nothing below), not through the ET art. 383 monthly table. Evidence: settlement 2 (Liquidacion!B46/C46/E46/J46) withholds WT 21129 at 20% on 150,340,410 = 200,453,880 less 25% = 30,068,000, separately from WT 2552 on the art. 383 base (E47 84,088,075); 'Acumulados- Prestaciones'!G29 carries the 204-UVT threshold 10,684,296; the October G2N (REF-P203-119) P14 = 48,095,372 = both amounts. Source paragraph unchanged.
